title: Chain of production template
subject: Business
unit: Spring 1: The international economy and government (1.5, 1.6)
source: Written for business/y10 lesson 13 (Pupil PDF worksheet: chain of production template)
intro: Lesson 13. Fill in each stage, label its sector (primary, secondary or tertiary) and say what happens there.

questions.q: Explain one way the sectors in your T-shirt chain depend on each other.
questions.a: For example: the retailer (tertiary) needs the factory (secondary) to supply stock on time, and the factory needs cotton from the farm (primary); a poor harvest raises costs all the way along.

blocks.answers: T-shirt: cotton farm (primary) → spinning and sewing factory (secondary) → shipping and retailer (tertiary). Chocolate: cocoa farm (primary) → chocolate factory (secondary) → wholesaler, transport and shop (tertiary).
